  namespace: boutique

    app: redis-cart

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart

      labels:
        app: redis-cart

        readinessProbe:

          periodSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: 6379
        livenessProbe:

          periodSeconds: 5

            port: 6379
        volumeMounts:

          name: redis-data
        resources:

            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 125m
          requests:
            cpu: 70m
            memory: 200Mi
      volumes:
      - name: redis-data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: redis-cart-pvc
